independenceEstimate: Publisher-domain and syndication estimate; shared ownership is not verified
dossierHelp: Generates a comprehensive, synthesized report from top-tier sources. Strictly deduplicated to avoid repeated content. (Max 50 sources analyzed).
dossierWarn: This performs multi-pass synthesis. Please allow 30-60 seconds. Only publicly available, high-credibility sources are analyzed.
dossierSignIn: Sign in free to generate a dossier
tryLine: Try a claim check or 1 report without an account. Create a free account for 3 reports, 3 fact-checks, and 3 citation scans monthly.
consensus: Two AI engines review the same retrieved excerpts. If they materially disagree, a third engine reviews the conflicting evidence. AI agreement is one input to confidence, not proof of accuracy.
hStrong: 2+ independent publishers, at least one Tier 1 (academic, government or institutional) source, and a source from the last two years.
hModerate: 2+ independent publishers or at least one Tier 1 source, but not all strong-evidence conditions are met.
hLimited: Only one independent publisher, without a Tier 1 source.
hConflicting: Independent sources disagree about this claim.
hInsufficient: Not enough verified evidence was found to assess the claim.
namedOrganization: Named publisher or organization visible in metadata
unknown: Unknown from retrieved metadata; neutral/low signal
dataLinked: Possible primary-data link inferred from metadata or URL; availability and contents not verified
methodsVisible: Study or methodology indicators visible; data not inspected
scoringCaution: Quality indicators are metadata-based estimates, not truth scores or full-source verification.
scoringWeights: Weights: authority 25%, recency 10%, independence 15%, author transparency 15%, directness 25%, original data 10%. Strong ≥80; Moderate ≥55; otherwise Weak.
